thread:
dina: Heads-up: planning a soft-unpin of runtime v2.18 for hosted canaries next Tue 02:00 UTC. Phased traffic shift: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Deadman thresholds + rollback commands in runbook.

deploy-bot: scheduled runtime-soft-unpin job id=job-c9a1 at 2025-04-08T02:00:00Z. Steps: shift -> wait(10m) -> shift -> wait(20m) -> full. Auto-rollback enabled.

ben: Question  Are legacy SDKs (sdk-1.x) incompatible with stream header change in 2.18? Need a routing rule for them during early phases.

alice: Yes, we changed the chunked-stream header negotiation. I'll add a route rule to keep sdk-1.x on runtime 2.17 for phases 1-2.

maria: Telemetry thresholds proposed:
- 5xx_rate > 0.75% sustained over 2m -> rollback
- p99_latency increase > 200ms vs baseline -> rollback
- per-tenant error spike > 3x baseline -> pager
I'll hook alerts to #incidents and the oncall pager.

sre-josh: Adding rollback command to runbook: `/deploy abort job-c9a1` will revert route map and halt job. Also adding manual-gate after phase2 for an explicit OK.

ben: Also saw a KV cache index shift in 2.18 that affects longseq models. We reproduced token-drop on 4k+ sequences. Recommend pinning longseq models for phases 1-2.

alice: Agree. I'll add pinlist entries for `model:llama3-longseq:v1` -> runtime=2.17 for phases 1-2. We'll auto-remove after 48h of stable metrics in phase3.

dina: Add a denylist for tenants known to send >2k tokens in production. Keep them pinned until phase3. Contact support for exceptions.

support-liz: I'll pre-send customer advisory to tenants on denylist and add an opt-in request process.

maria: Dashboards updated: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, token-length distribution. Extended logs retention +10m for canary window.

sre-josh: Stress run last night passed short sequences; longseq regression reproduced. With pinlist+denylist we should be safe.

alice: Draft internal release notes: "Runtime update v2.17 -> v2.18 on 2025-04-08 UTC. Long-sequence models may be served by pinned runtime for initial 48h. Contact support for special cases."

ben: Internal mitigation snippet to include in notes:
```
# rollback
/deploy abort job-c9a1
# pin tenant to old runtime
route set tenant=tenant-123 runtime=2.17 --until=2025-04-10T02:00:00Z
```

deploy-bot: phase=1 starting -> shifting 5% traffic now. Watch windows enabled.

dina: Owners: @sre-josh rollback, @maria telemetry, @alice customer comms, @ben compatibility mapping. Please ack.

sre-josh: Ack. I'll monitor runbook and be ready to abort.

maria: Ack. Alerts wired.

alice: Ack. Draft posted in 15m.

support-liz: Ack. Sending advisory to denylist tenants.

ben: Pushing pinlist PR now, linking shortly. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: phase=1 complete -> holding 10m. No rollback triggered. Next shift -> 25% in 10m.

dina: If anything looks off, hit abort and we revert. Otherwise proceed to phase2. Thanks team.
